name: Ferdinand von Hagen
profile: Listed by Hurun as a GoStudent founder, but public sources name Felix Ohswald and Gregor Müller as GoStudent's founders (Vienna, 2016). A CB Insights entry lists a Ferdinand von Hagen as former CTO of Studienkreis (a German tutoring firm acquired by GoStudent), with GoStudent, Deloitte, ETH Zurich and Airbus in his work history.
notes: Founder attribution looks wrong: he appears to be a tech executive (ex-CTO at Studienkreis, a GoStudent group company), not a co-founder. His current role isn't confirmed. Source: https://www.cbinsights.com/company/studienkreis/people. For GoStudent, the founders are Felix Ohswald (CEO) and Gregor Müller.
